blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Erika Santos delivered the telling blows as Capital1, playing without Bella Belen, beat Galeries Tower, 26-28, 25-19, 21-25, 25-19, 15-10, to end its 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series campaign on a high note Thursday at Mall of Asia Arena. Santos poured in 26 points off 23 kills and three blocks, while Vanie Gandler backstopped her with 20 points, 16 digs, and 10 excellent receptions as the Solar Spikers missed Belen’s services due to illness. “Vanie and I went into this match with the mindset that there was no turning back. We had to go all out, play without […]... Keep on reading: PVL: Capital1 edges Galeries to end Siklab Series on high note
